# ChannelPayloadFilter type

Predicate deciding whether one change should invalidate the cached method.

Returning `true` invalidates. Unlike the array form of [ChannelFilter](/api/pg-cache/latest/pg-cache.channelfilter/)<!-- -->, this reads the way you expect — see that type for the inversion.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ChannelPayloadFilter = (payload: ChannelPayload) => boolean;
```
